description: This file defines the DeprecatedNode class in the Twig templating engine, representing a node that triggers deprecation notices within compiled templates.

classes.name: DeprecatedNode
classes.description: Represents a deprecated node that triggers a deprecation warning during template compilation.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the DeprecatedNode with an expression and line number.

methods.name: compile
methods.description: Generates PHP code to trigger a deprecation warning, including optional package and version info.
